messages:
vikram: hey team, pinging for approvals on PR #24256 — I can't merge because CI is failing on macos-snapshot only. looks flaky across two runs. can someone with write approve or advise?

tara: taking a look now. quick summary of the failure?

vikram: it's the snapshot test for `RenderDiff` — assertion mismatch on a small style change. happens only on macos-shard-3. logs:```
FAIL tests/ui/render_diff_test.rs - expected snapshot to match
- expected: "button { margin: 8px }"
+ actual:   "button { margin: 8.0px }"
thread 'main' panicked at 'snap mismatch'
```

elaine: ugh, floating-point formatting again. looks like macOS toolchain prints decimals. is this from the new formatting patch in the PR?

vikram: yep, small clean-up in formatter. behavior is intended, but should we update the snapshot or normalize the output? updating snapshots will affect multiple tests.

mike: if it's consistent and intended, snapshot update seems fine, but we should be cautious. can we run a targeted rerun on only macos-shard-3 to confirm flake vs deterministic change? @sre-bot can you trigger a targeted rerun for buildkite job `pr-24256-macos-shard-3`? :pray:

sre-bot: queued targeted rerun for job pr-24256-macos-shard-3. I'll post result here when done.

james: fwiw, if we update snapshots we should add a tiny note in the changelog about formatter output. also prefer a short eval to make sure no downstream formatting regressions.

sre-bot: rerun finished — same failure reproduced on macos-shard-3 (build 98765).

tara: ok reproduced. since it's deterministic on macOS, please either: 1) normalize the formatter to drop trailing `.0` (preferred), or 2) update snapshots and add changelog + eval. which do you prefer, @vikram?

vikram: thanks — I can normalize the formatter in a follow-up, but it's a small, safe change. would prefer to ship this PR (non-format behavior) now. so if someone with merge permissions can approve and we mark the snapshot update as follow-up, that would help. otherwise I can fold the normalization here.

elaine: I'd rather not merge with a known snapshot mismatch. can you fold the normalization into this PR? should be a couple lines.

vikram: ok will push a small commit to normalize formatting (strip trailing .0 for integers) — pushing in 10m. will request re-run after.

mike: sounds good. once pushed I'll do a quick end-to-end and approve if green. :thumbsup:

vikram: pushed `fix/strip-dot-zero` (force-pushed a +1 commit). requesting targeted rerun again. @sre-bot please re-run pr-24256-macos-shard-3 and pr-24256-linux-shard-1 just to be safe.

sre-bot: queued targeted reruns for pr-24256-macos-shard-3 and pr-24256-linux-shard-1.

sre-bot: reruns completed. macos-shard-3 ✅ pass (build 98768). linux-shard-1 ✅ pass (build 98769).

mike: checked locally, snapshots look stable. approving now.

mike: APPROVED :white_check_mark:

james: quick note — file a tiny follow-up that adds a unit test for the formatter edge case. we had similar drift before.

vikram: will do, thanks all. merging after CI green and prow gating. :rocket:
